title: Creed opens first UK boutique outside of London in a thriving Northern beauty hub
summary: The L’Oréal-owned fragrance house has opened a 525sqft standalone store in the ‘dynamic cultural’ centre of Manchester, bringing Creed’s luxury craftsmanship to one of the UK’s biggest Northern beauty hotspots in a bid to expand its reach
